data.name: Settings_AboutText
data.value: Travel Vault is free and open source (MIT). No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Uses .NET MAUI (MIT), SQLite3 Multiple Ciphers (MIT), PdfPig (Apache-2.0), QRCoder (MIT), CommunityToolkit.Mvvm (MIT), Open Sans (OFL), Google ML Kit (on-device, free), airport data from mwgg/Airports (MIT), and the free ntfy.sh relay.
